results.statement: atm-core must run a repository-configured hook on task close (and later on the other task transitions) that receives role and a custom JSON payload defined by the hook, keeps the task open when the hook returns failure, and logs the result; until it ships, atm-task-close.py in the skill stands in for it.
results.quote: Long term, I would like this to occur in a atm-task-close hook which we could tap into.  we should file this as an important gh issue on atm-core repo because I don't believe this hook exists today.  we should assign hooks for most of the atm task transitions.  that would allow us to implement different hooks in different orchestration patterns.  the atm-task-close hook would accept a 'custom' json set of fields which would be defined by the custom python (not atm).  atm would simply pass the json to the python function which would return a Result<T,E> and if the hook returned failure, the task would remain open.  the result would get logged.  The atm-task-close hook would ALSO be routed by 'role' or 'role' would be a mandetory input argument to the python script
results.context: phase-bj planning 2026-10-18: Rand's close-hook and mechanical-assignment rulings (atm-core #1873 comment 1, atm-bd-orchestration #340, PR #342)
results.deterministic_check: with a configured hook that returns failure, atm task close <id> completed leaves the task active and the hook result appears in atm task events; with no hook configured the close behaves as today
